scope: competition implementation audit and bounded offline closure

paths: task snapshot, source/log retrieval and input boundaries
official SDK transport, network retry, model budget and unknown-result handling
Deep Agents tools, context selection, static Skills and diagnosis/repair decisions
candidate freeze, full-project checks, independent oracle and failure feedback
review.method: Three parallel read-only audits, root cross-checks, bounded fixes and a second independent review; tests ran sequentially in the existing managed Windows Job.
review.excluded: Frozen research extensions were not treated as competition blockers. No assertion of exhaustive whole-repository correctness or real model effectiveness.
review.conclusion: No remaining confirmed competition-path blocker from this review. P2 real provider and HarmonyOS admission remains necessary.

fixed.problem: Tool IDs legally reused across completed model turns were rejected by context grouping and provider history validation.
fixed.behavior: IDs are unique within the current assistant batch; completed later batches may reuse them. Outstanding/result pairing and model-parent-bound action IDs remain strict. Frozen historical bytes are not rewritten.

fixed.problem: A candidate could freeze without a diagnosis, then fail final localization acceptance with no way to attach the same patch later.
fixed.behavior: Competition requires a registered selected diagnosis with original root-cause lines before freezing. Rejection preserves the draft. Tool and prompt explain the repair path; the requirement is frozen in the session. Legacy offline defaults remain unchanged.

fixed.problem: A completed passing candidate was discarded when a final model message or extra tool exhausted the budget.
fixed.behavior: Pure model_budget/action_budget/wall_time stops do not invalidate a complete trustworthy latest check. Missing localization, latest failed or unknown checks, other stop errors and unknown model/tool results still prevent acceptance. Stop and cost facts remain recorded.

fixed.problem: Independent oracle files were checked only during configuration; later edits could silently change the acceptance test.
fixed.behavior: ApplicationProfile projects its single oracle declaration into frozen execution configuration. Each preparation/check stage verifies the approved external paths and bounded bytes before and after execution. New execution schema 3 records the binding. Missing bindings reject new application execution; old application receipts remain immutable and are read as inconclusive.

fixed.problem: Interrupted initialization could leave an empty receipt directory that returned inconclusive on check but failed on subsequent evidence/ledger read.
fixed.behavior: An entirely empty receipt directory exposes a read-only inconclusive view, without creating a main receipt or relaunching. A nonempty directory missing the main receipt is rejected. Extra completed-result checks apply only to application mode; synthetic report evidence still receives its ordinary validation.

validation.skip_reason: Windows account cannot create the symlink required by one test_local_execution counterexample; no ACL changes were attempted.

earlier_observations.purpose: Pre-fix baseline, not included in final-scope total.
Initial model/time budget fix; superseded by the eight-case final run including action_budget.

initial_failure.cause: New oracle projection assertion compared raw template JSON against the normalized model, omitting default max_bytes.
initial_failure.resolution: Compare against the validated oracle objects including their default read bound. No product or acceptance behavior was relaxed.

validation.evidence_location: Each managed receipt and matching log is under .dfx-local/artifacts/<receipt>.json and .log. Reproduction code and fixtures are tracked in tests; this record does not depend on archive.

integration.normal: Actual AsyncOpenAI/MockTransport + Deep Agents loop, 15 simulated model calls, first behavior check fails, second candidate passes all four synthetic stages, complete report/private delivery and zero-call resume.
integration.budget_boundary: Same chain with only 14 model calls; final check completes, model_budget is retained, synthetic_checked survives and resumed report bytes/model usage remain unchanged.
integration.application_acceptance: Tested with explicit host-receipt fixtures only; no actual HarmonyOS acceptance was produced.

next: P2: configure an actual cloud provider/model/key and bounded pilot budget; accept its tool continuation, usage, response shape and unknown-result handling.
P2: admit local HarmonyOS SDK/device/signing, reviewed source_mapping and independent build/target/business/regression checks; reproduce the original fault and confirm stopping/reset.

After admission: run a small baseline and paired enhancement pilot, then freeze broader evaluation. No accuracy, repair success, context savings or paper contribution effectiveness is currently established.
